The '''Drydust Crescent''' was the region of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that lay north of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Ila]].<ref name="TOR:DC" /> The [[Ugarra Dunes]] were located in the middle of the Crescent.
